items.body_excerpt: Brian Keefe said it's unclear who won't be available to play Thursday in the preseason opener. "No one will play heavy minutes or anything like that, but expect to see a lot of guys out there tomorrow," Keefe said. Tristan Vukčević (hip impingement) and Jamir Watkins (ACL recovery) will not play.
